finding.comment: the gate slurps the JSONL into an array before taking length, so the non-emptiness test matches the documented format

files.patch:
--- a/scripts/plan_gate.sh
+++ b/scripts/plan_gate.sh
@@ -5,4 +5,5 @@
 set -euo pipefail
+jq -c '.jobs[]' <<<"$plan" >>"$jobs_jsonl"
+test "$(jq -s 'length > 0' <"$jobs_jsonl")" = true
+echo "plan has jobs"
